auth.note: All 3 booking-flow endpoints below require a logged-in user (any role, USER included).

platformDetection.note: Web-only / App-only coupons are gated server-side. The client CANNOT bypass it - the server resolves the platform from the request itself.
platformDetection.fallback: If the header is missing it is resolved from User-Agent / Origin. Default = Web.

endpoints.name: Get Active Offers (OFFERS & COUPONS panel)
endpoints.usedBy: The offers list shown in the booking screen

queryParams.appliesTo: Court  (send this for the court booking flow)

data.description: 20% off on your first court booking

emptyResponse.note: This is what makes the UI show 'No active offers right now'

filterLogic: sportComplexId IS NULL (all venues) OR = requested sportComplexId
sportId IS NULL (all sports) OR = requested sportId

endpoints.name: Validate / Apply Coupon Code
endpoints.usedBy: The APPLY button next to the COUPON CODE box

requestFields.amount: number | optional | booking amount before discount. If omitted, discountAmount / finalAmount / originalAmount are NOT returned
requestFields.appliesTo: string | optional but send 'Court' | blocks event-only coupons
requestFields.eventPassId: null   | not used in the court booking flow

data.description: 20% off on your first court booking

responseFields.discountAmount: Calculated discount. Percentage is capped by maxDiscount; Flat is capped at amount
responseFields.note: These 3 fields appear ONLY when 'amount' is sent in the request

body.message: This coupon can only be used on the website
This coupon can only be used on the mobile app
This coupon is only valid for event bookings
This coupon is not valid for the selected sports complex
This coupon is only valid for Badminton bookings

endpoints.importantNote: Every failure is HTTP 400 (not 404). Show 'message' directly to the user - it is already user-friendly.

endpoints.name: Create Court Booking WITH Coupon (final redemption)
endpoints.usedBy: The PAY / CONFIRM button - this is where usedCount is incremented

requestFields.totalAmount: ORIGINAL price BEFORE discount. Do NOT send the discounted amount - the backend re-applies the coupon itself, so sending the discounted value discounts it twice.
requestFields.couponCode: string | optional | send null when no coupon is applied
requestFields.note: Court is auto-selected by the server (auto-shift). Legacy payload also supported: { courtId, date, startTime, endTime, totalAmount, couponCode }

body.message: date, startTime and endTime are required
Login required to book a court
Slot already booked: courtId 17 on 2026-08-28 from 18:00:00 to 19:00:00

couponLifecycle: usedCount is incremented at booking creation, inside the DB transaction
Booking is created as Pending with a holdExpiresAt hold
On successful payment -> booking Confirmed + QR pass issued
On cancel / abandoned checkout / expired hold -> the coupon use is given back (usedCount decremented)

adminCrud.note: Coupon master. ADMIN / COMPLEX_ADMIN / permitted EMPLOYEE only. The same router is mounted at both /api/coupons and /api/admin/coupons.

endpoints.returns: { success, data: [...], pagination: { currentPage, totalPages, total, itemsPerPage } }

createRequestBody.description: 20% off on your first court booking

createErrors.message: Missing required fields: code, discountType, discountValue, validUntil
Selected sport does not belong to the selected sports complex

rules: code is uppercased and unique; code CANNOT be changed on update
appliesTo = 'Court' -> eventPassId is forced to null
appliesTo = 'Event' -> sportComplexId and sportId are forced to null
sportId sent without sportComplexId -> the complex is derived from the sport
COMPLEX_ADMIN is forced to appliesTo = 'Court' and its own sportComplexId

dataTypeNote: DECIMAL columns (discountValue, maxDiscount, totalAmount, discountAmount) come back from PostgreSQL as STRINGS in list and booking responses, e.g. "20.00". Only /api/coupons/validate returns them as JSON numbers. Parse before doing math.
